24th Imperial Crusade.title: 24th Imperial Crusade
24th Imperial Crusade.description:
This article describes the Amarr faction warfare corporation. For information about faction warfare mechanics, see Faction Warfare.

The 24th Imperial Crusade is a capsuleer auxiliary of the Amarr Navy that is dedicated to pacifying the low sec areas that are contested between the Amarr Empire and the Minmatar Republic. It was founded in YC110 following the CONCORD Emergency Militia War Powers Act.

A Beacon Beckons.title: A Beacon Beckons
A Beacon Beckons.description:
--The mission can be completed remotely, and the next mission can be accepted remotely.--

This is a very easy mission - there is no danger of attack. You can do this mission in an unarmed shuttle, in fact. Just fly to the center of the wrecks. Check out the dreadnought wrecks - they're interesting to see. You can complete this mission remotely when you achieve the objective.

Approach the wrecked ships. Location: Manarq (0.8)
Notes

Abyssal Artifact Recovery.title: Abyssal Artifact Recovery
Abyssal Artifact Recovery.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

You are tasked with excavating Triglavian artifacts from Admixti Mutanite asteroids appearing in waves from an abyssal rift. Triglavians, Rogue Drones, and Sleepers (with Drifters) will try to stop you. You must mine quickly and survive.
After an initial setup period of 90 seconds, asteroids from beyond the rift will appear and a timer will begin. The site will progress through a total of 9 waves divided into three tiers. The enemy fleet compositions will become more difficult and the wave timers become shorter with each tier.
During each wave, a random Abyssal Weather effect will begin and 12 asteroids will spawn in fixed locations. Each asteroid contains 27 ore (Admixti Mutanite), each with a mass of 4 m3, for a total of 108 m3. The presence of these asteroids causes an anti-warp bubble until all 12 are depleted. 
Mining the asteroids can also expose Faulty Triglavian caches containing artifacts. These caches are time-limited structures and must be destroyed quickly to recover their contents.

A wave is cleared only if all asteroids are depleted before the timer ends; otherwise, the site fails. The warp disruption bubble remains until every asteroid is mined. Each completed wave pays out based on its difficulty tier.

Alt missioning.title: Alt missioning
Alt missioning.description:
In a peaceful universe, we would all be free to mission to our heart's content without any unwanted interference. But EVE is not a peaceful universe. War seems to loom over the University almost constantly, and during such times it can be dangerous to run missions on your Uni Main, as War Targets can engage you without repercussion. This guide will attempt to give instruction on a method of using a second account to complete missions relatively safely while allowing you to continue making progress on your standings with your main. This method requires using an out-of-corp alt on a second account.

Form a fleet with your University character.
Invite the out-of-corp alt.
Have the alt accept the mission.
Bring the alt to the system where the mission destination is located and dock.
Using a cheap ship, travel to the system with the mission bookmark with your Uni character and dock at the same station as your alt.
Check local for hostiles. Do not undock if there are hostiles in local.
Undock both characters (carefully), alt first.
Orbit close (less than 2000 m) to the station or use an insta-undock bookmark.
From your Uni character, warp the fleet towards the mission bookmark. (You can do this in the same right-click-activated context menu where you select "Warp to location".)
Immediately stop your Uni character's ship by pressing CTRL + SPACE and dock up. Do not let your ship enter warp.
Perform the mission with the alt.
Complete the mission with the main back at the station.

An Economy Under Threat.title: An Economy Under Threat
An Economy Under Threat.description:
Objective
Deliver 1 x Farming Supplies (150 m³) to the storage warehouse in Hatakani.
Notes
--You can complete this mission and accept the next one remotely.--
This is a simple transport mission. Check your cargo hold - the farming supplies require 150 cubic meters as warned by Agent Asaka. You'll warp to an acceleration gate. After activating the gate, you'll arrive in a deadspace area - the Storage Warehouse container will be 16km away.
You'll get a message from Asaka: The Caldari forces look far better prepared this time around. “Anti-support” Frigates and Cruisers flank their larger allies, standing ready and able to deal with any smaller hostiles that come their way. If these drones try to escape, the faster and more agile ones won’t slip past the amassed fleet so easily now.
The rogue drones won't bother you if you don't bother them. Simply travel to the warehouse and drop your cargo into it. Your mission objectives will then be fulfilled. You can complete the mission remotely - you'll then receive this message from Agent Asaka: Yes, I just received word from the colony. They should be able to stick to their production schedule, which is great news. Thank you, pilot, you’ve done the Caldari people a great service today. If you need any further help with your drone investigation, just say the word.

Next Mission: Every Drone Inside

An Eye on Everything.title: An Eye on Everything
An Eye on Everything.description:
Objective
Warp to the smuggling hub at the designated mission location in Hek, investigate, and report back to Agent Eslin.
Notes
Warp to the designated location. You will find yourself about 50km away from a sizable pirate fleet consisting of 3 frigates, 12 cruisers, and 7 battleships, plus a Nidhoggur class carrier.
Don't attack! Don't move! Don't do anything!
You'll get a message from Agent Eslin: "Looks like they're still getting reinforcements. They even have a stolen Nidhoggur. Alright, I have all the information I need, good work. Get back to me before they realize you're there, and we can discuss what comes next."
Before you fly back to the station and complete the mission, take a moment to do a "Look At" on the Nidhoggur carrier. You usually see these only in low-sec or 0.0 space, so check it out before leaving. The fleet won't attack if you simply look at them.
If you still want to fight the pirates just to get that high sec carrier kill, here are the details on the rats:
The carrier neuts 1200 GJ/30 seconds (40 GJ/s), but does no damage and does not have fighters. The carrier will only aggress if you approach close to it or attack it. Simply attacking the other ships will not agro the carrier. There are no warp disruptors in this mission. It is recommended to destroy all the other ships before attacking the carrier, that way you will not have to deal with the neuting while under fire. After all the other ships are dead, you can attack the carrier. When attacking the carrier, you should either use weapons that don't require capacitor (projectile weapons, missiles, or drones) or have a lot of cap batteries, rechargers, and/or cap boosters. The carrier will always stay stationary and is immune to all forms of EWAR and tackle. The carrier always drops a 5,000,000 ISK Minmatar Rear Admiral Tag, and may drop a large quantity of marines and small arms. The carrier does not drop capital modules, and does not have any noteworthy salvage. Salvaging the carrier will not yield T2 salvage. 
Most of the incoming damage will come from the Serpentis and Angel battleships. The best way to destroy the pirate fleet is to keep at range, perhaps with a micro jump drive, and use long range weapons. A marauder or a Rattlesnake is recommended due to the high damage. When all the ships are close, the damage can exceed 600dps. The carrier can take several minutes to burn down even with a marauder, so it is recommended to engage it last.

~11 million ISK

Anatomy of Incursions.title: Anatomy of Incursions
Anatomy of Incursions.description:
This article is not intended to be a step-by-step manual on how to lead an incursion fleet, but rather an article bringing up all the various aspects of running a site. To make sure you are aware of all the choices you'll need to be making and how they are influenced by what site you're doing, how your fleet members have fitted their ships, the skills they have and to what level of autonomy you can rely on them to perform without specific orders.
While primarily for people looking to step up and lead fleets, this article also serves as good read for players who wish to understand why things are done in a certain way, which helps them become more autonomous. Having pilots in the fleet who are able to adapt on the fly, knowing what works and what doesn't, is a tremendous asset to the fleet commander and greatly improved not only efficiency but also fleet safety. Just remember that while you're often given a certain amount of freedom, if the fleet commander gives you a specific order, follow it.
In short, this article is focused on making you aware of all the related things so that you have a proper foundation on which to improve your own performance or build your personal fleet commanding style tailored to the kind of fleets you'll run.
The Incursion fitting principles page is a great complement to this page, going through the various fitting choices.

Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony.title: Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony
Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony.description:
The Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 4/10) type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems.
The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller.
This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.
(Note - Tech 3 cruisers are not supported by the entrance gate)

Angel Hideaway.title: Angel Hideaway
Angel Hideaway.description:
Angel Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Minmatar Republic or occupied by the Angel Cartel. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Domination faction modules and ammunition. 
This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Angel Repurposed Outpost complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Angel Hidden Hideaway, Angel Forsaken Hideaway and Angel Forlorn Hideaway.

Angel's Red Light District is a DED Complex (rated 5/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems, or as an escalation from Angel Refuge or Angel Den.
The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site.
This site's acceleration gate allows all subcapitals to enter.

Anomic missions.title: Anomic missions
Anomic missions.description:
Anomic Missions (also known as Burner Missions or Anomic Burner Missions) are Level 4 Security Missions. They can be declined without a Standing Penalty. Similar to Abyssal Deadspace, Anomic Missions are a more advanced and challenging type of PvE combat content.
Anomic Missions are unique because you will:

fight a few powerful ships designed to imitate capsuleers using excellent Skills, Faction Modules, Implants and Combat Boosters.
pilot a small Ship Class, equipped with expensive and powerful modules
need to use overheating, manually pilot your ship, and have well-trained character skills
receive a large amount of ISK, Loyalty Points and even valuable faction modules to use or sell to other players
Anomic Missions often require careful thought about fitting your ship for the challenge. You are encouraged to try out your Ship Fittings for Anomic Missions on the Singularity Test Server when it's available, as doing this will let you determine what works well without putting expensively-ships at risk.

Ascending Nobles.description:
[Video: [Typhoon June 2021]
The destination is Reteka (7 jumps).
This mission can be requested and accepted remotely.
Tips:

All spawns start approximately 80k from warp in.
The Veteran/Elite battleships do very heavy damage if you let them get close (They orbit ~49k and hit hard up to 60k away).
The elite battleships are very slow (139 m/s). If you keep them at 60+ km tanking won't be hard.
The green-crewed battleships on the other hand are very weak for battleships.
Single gated deadspace pocket. Once all ships are destroyed the mission object drops near the Amarr chapel.
The last ship destroyed in each group will trigger the next wave.

Assistance.title: Assistance
Assistance.description:
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket zero jumps away in the same System.
Blitz: destroy all Mercenary Overlords, then destroy the single newly spawned Mercenary Overlord.
Tips:

Approach Audalle Roire with a throwaway ship to spawn the enemies, then warp at 100 km with your combat ship.
Group 1 spawns about 5 seconds after the trigger (a message pops up to let you know), giving you some time to warp out; you can circle around the trigger to align with a celestial first
The rest of the hostile spawn appears in rapid succession and will be right on top of you.
Mercenary Overlords deal 70% Thermal damage over 30 km range and approach at 300 m/s, with limited damage projection past 25 km. Because of the fast spawn rate, there will be 12 of them attacking you at once. You should either be fit to face-tank nearly 2000 DPS of (mostly) Kinetic and Thermal damage or quickly kill the Mercenary Wingmen outside of their webbing range and speed-tank.
Mercenary Wingmen only have a 1% chance of having a warp disruptor, but better safe than sorry
You do not need to destroy any ship except for the Mercenary Overlords

Besieged Covert Research Facility.title: Besieged Covert Research Facility
Besieged Covert Research Facility.description:
This page is about the Combat Site. See Ghost Sites for info on the hacking site

The Besieged Covert Research Facility is a Mordu's Legion combat anomaly. It can be found in any region of empire space, but only in Low Security systems. They are the only normal combat anomaly that can spawn in Faction warfare systems.
You will need:

a ship that can sustain fire from up to five Battleships, a passive buffer Gila with Vespa and Kin/Therm resists can do this site in approx. 10-12 mins.
a Stealth Bomber with an oversized afterburner and missile precision enhancers. This method relies completely on speed tanking and cannot absorb more than one or two lucky hits from the battleships, and necessitates Tech II torpedo fits and high navigation skills to reliably complete the sites. Requires at least 500 DPS (Kinetic) to complete.
Tips:

No faction standing penalty for killing Mordu's ships.
All ships fly up to 380m/s
All ships have active shield tank
Kinetic is the best damage to both deal and resist.
The Cruiser's missiles deal Kinetic damage
The Battleship's high accuracy and infinite range Thermal/Kinetic/EM turrets deal 350 damage per shot, while their cruise missiles deal 900 Kinetic damage per shot.
The Commander's turrets deal all damage types, but have poor tracking; and their 54 km range torpedoes deal Kinetic damage
On paper, the highest possible incoming DPS is 1040 (170 EM, 250 Thermal, 620 Kinetic) with 5 Battleships, before taking into account resists and relative signature radius.
You should deal Kinetic damage because:

The Cruiser is weak to EM, but has low HP so high Kinetic volley damage can still kill it quickly
The Battleship's shields are weak to EM and armor is weak to Explosive, but the lowest average resistance is Thermal with Kinetic at close second
The Commander has the highest EHP of the three ships but its weakest average resistance is Kinetic
You should also put emphasis on primarily resisting Kinetic damage (while maintaining omni tank) since the cruiser lacks turrets and its missiles deal purely Kinetic damage, while the battleships output more DPS in Kinetic than all other damage types combined.

Blitzing.title: Blitzing
Blitzing.description:
Blitzing missions is an alternative way of doing missions that can be highly profitable - you do not completely clear the room(s) and kill every rat. Instead, you enter the mission, kill only the ships that absolutely need to get killed for mission completion, and then leave instantly to turn the mission in.
If you fly this way, most of the money that comes from missions does not come from loot/salvage/bounties, but from the LP.

Blood Den.title: Blood Den
Blood Den.description:
Blood Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Blood Raider Covenant pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Dark Blood faction modules and ammunition. 
This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-, Destroyer- and Cruiser-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Blood Raider Psychotropics Depot complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Blood Hidden Den, Blood Forsaken Den and Blood Forlorn Den.

Booster Manufacturing (Blue Pill).title: Booster Manufacturing (Blue Pill)
Booster Manufacturing (Blue Pill).description:
Guristas COSMOS mission
Agents: Ocho Shusiian, Ozomi Obanen, Vena Saapialen, Fetosa Kanim
Standings required: None

Booster manufacturing is a single run mission found in null security COSMOS constellations. Each agent will give this mission only once.

Simple trade mission where the agent requests some Cytoserocin and gives a booster BPC as a reward. The gas can be mined locally if you have a Venture or Prospect and core probes. Alternatively you can use a Blockade Runner or prospect to haul the gas from elsewhere. This mission can be completed once for each agent.

Accept the Mission remotely.
Gated deadspace pocket one jumps away in K-QWHE. Destroy all ships and take the Gate until you reach the last Room. Destroy the Boundless Creations Data Center and warp out.

You only need to destroy the final Boundless Creations Data Center to complete the mission

Building mission bases.title: Building mission bases
Building mission bases.description:
This guide should help you if you feel that your assets get messed up and spread over dozens of systems so that it's hard to find the stuff you need. It explains how to choose and establish a 'base' for running regular missions efficiently in a particular system in highsec.
Setting up bases is also a way to get very familiar with an area. Rather than moving around a lot and doing missions over the whole of high sec, you can stay in one location where you know all the agents and are familiar with the local tradehubs.

Burning Down the Hive.title: Burning Down the Hive
Burning Down the Hive.description:
The epic arc has a few missions that can be difficult - and "Burning Down the Hive" is one of these. Rare is the new player who does not suffer his or her first ship loss in this mission.
The first room of this mission features multiple Strain Infester Alvi rogue drones that webify and warp disrupt your ship. If the rats get within range and point you, then you will not be able to warp out of the mission deadspace to preserve your ship. This is one of the only Level 1 missions that has warp disrupting rats; you will not see them commonly again until Level 3 missions.

Chasing Shadows.description:
This is the second difficult mission of the epic arc. It is similar in difficulty to Burning Down the Hive.
Kritsan Parthus is flying an Independent Harbinger/Prophecy (Battlecruiser), escorted by five Mercenary Rookie frigates. Parthus' ship will neut (drain your capacitor) if you get too close. It appears to have a range of 30km. He will also tracking disrupt your ship.
Kritsan Parthus has 30% EM resistance and 50% KIN resistance, so EM damage towards that cruiser is recommended.

Chasing a Nightmare.description:
--You can complete this mission and accept the next one remotely.--
Warp to the mission site. Then follow Wolf Burgan's instructions that pop-up. You will travel through one acceleration gate and then three “Spatial Rift” gates that act the same way as an acceleration gate. You will see the Mysterious Drone as you warp in, but it will quickly leave (making the Spatial Rifts upon exit). After the second drone sighting, Bargan will lose the signal and the mission can be completed remotely.

Church Of The Obsidian.title: Church Of The Obsidian
Church Of The Obsidian.description:
Two deadspace pockets up to three jumps away from Tanoo.
Blitz: kill all Frigates, lure them away or rush through the Ancient Acceleration Gate. Rush for the Chapel of the Obsidian, hack it, loot the Blood Obsidian Orb and warp out.
Alternative Blitz: lure ships 150 km away in the second room, turn around and approach enemy at a 45-degree angle; at the enemy fleet midpoint turn towards the Chapel of the Obsidian, hack it, loot the Blood Obsidian Orb and warp out.
Tips:

You cannot warp inside either room
Destroy Warp Scrambling Frigates if you cannot avoid them. They are positioned around the gate and do not aggro on warp-in, but they will still tackle you before you get to the gate unless you're cloaked
The frigates in the first room will instantly move back to the acceleration gate if you warp out, so you can only avoid them solo with a Micro Jump Drive or fast ship.
Armor tanked Battlecruisers such as Prophecies, Myrmidons and Hurricanes can ignore the incoming DPS and go straight for the Chapel of the Obsidian

Confiscated Smuggler Hideout.description: The Confiscated Smuggler Hideout is a Capsuleer Day XIX event site and a variant of the Smuggler Hideout. It consists of two gated pockets. You have to clear most of the NPCs in the first pocket to make the acceleration gate to the second pocket usable. In the second pocket, your goal is to destroy the Smuggler Captain which drops various loot (2 possible spawn). The number of NPC spawns and their size depends on the highest ship class used, especially T3 cruisers lead to significantly more NPCs. The number of ships entering doesn't affect the spawns though. This site do not provide bounties as you will fight SARO ships (non-pirate NPC).

Corruption and Suppression.title: Corruption and Suppression
Corruption and Suppression.description:
Corruption and Suppression are related mechanics, indicating the control of solar system by pirate or empire forces.
As insurgency content is completed by either the Pirate or Empire militias, systems will increase in Corruption or Suppression. When certain thresholds of Corruption or Suppression are reached, the system will go up to the next Corruption or Suppression stage. Each stage can bring in new effects and shape the rules of the system. Currently(23 September 2026), only Pirate Insurgencies can affect Corruption or Suppression, but future game mechanics could as well.

Cowardly Commander.title: Cowardly Commander
Cowardly Commander.description:
Video: [Typhoon June 2021]
Blitz: Take the acceleration gates to the last room. Kill elite frigates if they point you. In last room triger the wave 2 and destroy it.

The mission is completed when last ship in third room wave 2 dies. This mission can be completed remotely and the next mission can be accepted remotely.
Tips:

The pockets are not deadspace. You can bm them and warp back if you take too much damage.
The acceleration gates are NOT locked.
Be prepared for very heavy dps and large amounts of EWAR
Make sure to prioritize targets (destroy EWAR ships first)
Energy neutralizer towers are always primary targets
To avoid getting neuted and scramed while traveling to the next gate, you can create pingspots while warping in into every room. Warp back to your ping, then warp to the next gate at 0 km.
The Sansha Commander will be present in each room as you warp-in and will warp away without engaging.

Dal Segno Al Fine.title: Dal Segno Al Fine
Dal Segno Al Fine.description:
Warp to the acceleration gate and take it. You will see an Armageddon, a Tempest, a Raven, and a Dominix. You'll also see a drone hive in the distance. Drop Dagan off into the Cargo Wreathe and you are finished with the arc. There are no enemies to fight for this final mission. But be sure to watch what happens to the drone hive nearby after you drop Dagan into the prison transport. Fly back to your selected agent to turn in the mission and complete the arc.
After turning your final mission, you'll get something similar to this dialogue: "The rogue drones did what? That's the damndest thing. I've heard that they can think for themselves, but I've never heard of them just watching like that. There's something much larger going on than we realize. Regardless, you've been a tremendous help. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod."
Depending on what faction you selected in mission 49, you will receive a base +0.7 faction standing increase. (This standing increase will be higher if you have trained Social, up to a maximum increase of 0.875.)
Congratulations! You've finished the Sisters of EVE epic arc!
As noted above, you can repeat this arc every three months. Because of the option to select which faction will give the standing increase, repeating The Blood-Stained Stars can be an effective tool for repairing low standing with a faction.

Delivering a Doctor.title: Delivering a Doctor
Delivering a Doctor.description:
Video: [Talwar April 2020]
Deliver ransom money (provided by Sister Alitura) for Dr. Lujia Elban (1.0 m³). Then bring back Dr. Elban to the agent.
Notes
Be sure to put the "A Lot of Money" item (3.0 m³) into your ship's cargo hold before leaving the station.
You will warp in 15km from a container called "Dead Drop". After placing the money in the container, the pirates will appear at ~25 km range and attack you.
After destroying the second wave, the doctor silently and magically appears in your cargo hold. Return to the Sisters of EVE Bureau station to report back to Sister Alitura and complete the mission.
Anyone thinking about trying to get the money back from the dead drop should know that although the dead drop can be damaged, the money is destroyed along with it if you blow it up.

Drone Herd.description: Drone Herd is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). This combat site has a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops rogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. Drone Surveillance.title: Drone Surveillance
Drone Surveillance.description:
Drone Surveillance is an unrated combat site belonging to the Rogue Drones faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly in low-security and null-security systems across New Eden. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). 
There are two variations of this combat site. The first variation takes place in the ruins of a megastructure and includes Light Missile Batteries in the initial wave. The second variation takes place inside an asteroid-filled cloud and includes Defense Vampire (nosferatu) batteries instead. Both variations have a chance to spawn a Sentient commander rogue drone, which drops drogue components and may drop faction drone modules and items. This site has a chance to escalate to Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.

Every Drone Inside.title: Every Drone Inside
Every Drone Inside.description:
Objective
Neutralize every drone inside the quarantine area - Location: Hatakani (0.9)
Notes
This is a straightforward kill mission. There are 15 (drone/frigate) Rogue Drones attacking you in this mission, however, and you can get overwhelmed if your combat skills are undeveloped. Fit an afterburner on your ship, and be ready to use a kiting strategy - that is, set your "keep at range" combat control to your optimal weapon range, then turn on your afterburner and use that to keep at your optimal distance from each target, starting with the closest targets first. That will maximize your damage while keeping the drones at a safer distance. Remember: if you start to get overwhelmed, warp out - you can always warp back in after some repairs.
You'll warp to an acceleration gate. Once in the deadspace area, you'll find yourself at about 100 km from 15 Rogue Drone ships. When you approach, they will all target you at 65 km, and close to attack.

Next Mission: A Sense of Dread

Faction warfare.title: Faction warfare
Faction warfare.description:
This page deals primarily with the mechanics of faction warfare. For tips on how best to take advantage of these mechanics, see Faction warfare strategy and tactics.
Faction warfare (FW) is a game mechanic whereby you can sign up to fight for one of the four empire factions (against its enemy faction) for control over certain areas of low-sec space. It was first introduced in the Empyrean Age expansion (2008) to offer players a stepping-stone into player-vs-player (PvP) gameplay. In 2022, the Uprising expansion made sweeping changes across many Faction Warfare mechanics, and the Havoc expansion (2023) added the ability to enlist with the Guristas and Angels pirate militias to fight against the empires and participate in Insurgencies.
Faction warfare is primarily centered around two war zones (areas of low-sec contested by two empires): the Amarr-Minmatar war zone and the Caldari-Gallente war zone, which each are located on the border of the two respective empires. In these war zones, players who participate in Factional Warfare attempt to conquer star systems for their empire, and are rewarded with loyalty points and increased faction standings for their efforts. Additionally, as players who participate in Factional Warfare are effectively at war with one of the four empire factions in the game, they can therefore attack (and be attacked by) players fighting for the enemy faction anywhere in New Eden, as well as fight the enemy NPC faction navies (who patrol the high-sec star systems belonging to their faction). 
In addition to fighting their rival empire militia, players who participate in Factional Warfare are also at war with one of the two pirate militias as part of the Pirate Insurgency. Members of the Amarr and Minmatar militias are at war with the Angel Cartel, while members of the Caldari and Gallente militias are fighting the Guristas Pirates. In insurgency warzones, empire militia members can capture plexes to increase Suppression, and pirate militia members can capture plexes to increase Corruption.

Faction warfare missions.title: Faction warfare missions
Faction warfare missions.description: Pilots enlisted in Faction Warfare may run faction warfare missions offered by agents of the four Factional Warfare NPC corporations ("militias"). These missions work similarly to the encounter missions offered by agents of Empire corporations, although there are a few notable differences (detailed below). Note that these missions do not contribute to the core Factional Warfare mechanics (capturing or defending star systems in the war zones), although they take place in the same regions of space.

Faction warfare standings.title: Faction warfare standings
Faction warfare standings.description: Some pilots may be concerned that joining Factional Warfare will result in irreparable damage to some of their faction standings, either excluding them from a quarter of Empire space for the rest of their EVE career, or forcing them to grind their standings back up. This page aims to clarify how your standings are affected by participating in Factional Warfare.

Faction warfare strategy and tactics.title: Faction warfare strategy and tactics
Faction warfare strategy and tactics.description: In Factional Warfare you can fight for one of the four empires against its enemies for control over areas of low-sec. This page gives tips on how to make the most of the PvE and PvP opportunities in Factional Warfare (FW); for a more detailed look at the FW mechanics see Factional Warfare. Additionally, there are detailed pages on running missions in Factional Warfare and the impact of Factional Warfare on your standings.

From Way Above.title: From Way Above
From Way Above.description:
Accept the Mission remotely.
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket zero jumps away in Todeko. All warps will land you at the same point, but you can warp around freely.
Complete the Mission remotely.
Blitz: warp in, then warp to bookmark. Wait for 10 minutes for the final spawn to arrive and destroy the 2x Elite Battleships (Gist Domination Saint/Nephilim).
Tips:

A new spawn appears after a minute, then after 2, then after 3 and the final spawns after 4 minutes
2x Elite Battleships (Gist Domination Saint/Nephilim) Target Painting is effective even at 100KM
Battleships can't hit at close range due to poor tracking
Ships spawn around 70 km away from warp-in, all around the same spot. Large amount of elite cruisers will make speed-tanking difficult if you don't have very strong Explosive resist.

Fuel Gauge.title: Fuel Gauge
Fuel Gauge.description:
Accept the Mission remotely.
Gated deadspace pocket up to four jumps away.
Blitz: destroy ships at warp in and take the Acceleration Gate. Destroy Fuel Depot Alpha and warp out.
Tips:

You do not have to destroy the Caldari Stasis Towers to activate the Acceleration Gate
You will lose 2.4% Caldari State Faction Standing if you destroy a Caldari Stasis Tower
Don't stay and fight; destroy any Fuel Depot and warp out - only one needs to be destroyed to complete the mission
Watch out for Elite Frigates as they Warp Scramble
Frigates and Destroyers are not harmed by the Fuel Depot explosion
Each battleship will drop a Caldari Navy Vice Admiral Insignia I; bookmark the site and return after turning in the Mission. Total tag loot amounts to ~60M ISK.

Heresiology.title: Heresiology
Heresiology.description:
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket within three jumps.
Blitz: kill all Frigates, rush and hack up to six Ammatar Relics.
Alternative Blitz: lure ships 150 km away, warp to the Ammatar Relics, hack up to six of them and warp out.
Notes:

You can Bookmark and warp inside the room
Keep your standing loss to a minimum by avoiding killing any Ammatar Navy Detectives. Killing other ships will give minor (-0.006) Ammatar Mandate standing loss.
Hacking an Ammatar Relics can spawn another Ammatar Relics which must also be hacked.
All Ammatar Relics hacks are Very Easy difficulty.
A maximum of 6 Ammatar Relics can spawn and the Engraved Blood Obsidian Tablet is always dropped by the final one you need to hack
The Relics drop cargo containers when hacked, containing lore items and the objective item
Kakoti Rend will briefly appear as a non-hostile NPC when the final relic is hacked
Destroy Warp Scrambling Frigates if you cannot avoid them, but unlike the previous mission they are easily lured away from the objective
Complete the hacks in one session. If you leave for a while, they'll reset and will need to be hacked again in the order they spawned in, which can be impossible to keep track of if you don't bookmark and number them.

History of Incursions.title: History of Incursions
History of Incursions.description:
The history of Incursions is long and storied. Game balance changes by CCP over the years have both indirectly and directly changed the shape of Incursions and the groups that run them.
This page serves largely as a collection of devblogs and patches documenting the history of Incursions and EVE University's Incursion Community. While it is a very social activity, given their subjective importance, non-balance change events are limited to those that had a substantive impact on E-UNI's Incursion Community or on the larger Incursion community.

Hunting the Lieutenants.title: Hunting the Lieutenants
Hunting the Lieutenants.description:
Objective
Clear the facility of hostiles and capture any of the lieutenants present. The mission objective location is located within the Lustrevik system.
Notes
Warp to the encounter location. You will be about 30km away from seven Mercenary Rookie ships. They all will soon target lock you. They were no challenge for a frigate ship (e.g. Rifter). After you kill them all a popup will display a message from the lieutenant and Tarak Errand will say:
"We were scanning the radio chatter of those guys you took out. They were trying to evacuate someone from that Habitation Module. It's vulnerable now without them guarding it, so you can fire a few rounds off into the building. That should flush him out."
After you have shot the Habitation Module (you do not have to destroy it completely) the next popup from the lieutenant will display:
"Alright, alright! Stop shooting, I’ll come with you!"
The mission is completed. You do not need to loot anything just safely warp back to the agent's home base.
When you turn in Tarak Errand will say:
"Good work, <Pilot>. I had a feeling we’d find at least one of them there. We’ll take him out back and encourage him to talk."

Incipient Drone Swarm.title: Incipient Drone Swarm
Incipient Drone Swarm.description:
Incipient Drone Swarm is a Rogue Drone combat anomaly that spawns in Pochven.  The site is the easiest of the Pochven anomalies and is generally run only for the loot and standings.
The site has three waves, each dealing around 200 DPS.  The Rogue Drones (excluding Vexing and Punishing types) have a lot of EWAR, but it is very weak and can be easily ignored.
All rats, except for the occasional "Overmind" ships, are drone-sized targets.  None of the ships, including battleships, warp scramble.  Rats can drop Interstellar Navigation Logs which can be traded to Triglavian stations for valuable items.  The salvage is the same as with Rogue Drones in K-Space.
The Overminds deal around 50-100 DPS each and are limited to a 58 km range, but have very high tracking within that range (100+, equivalent to frigate tracking speeds). They have a lot of EHP, often around or over 100K, but can be tanked fairly easily.  Most of them have a large signature radius and can be hit relatively easily.  They will orbit you at around 45-50 km.  Recommended weapons to destroy them include torpedoes and cruise missiles due to their good application and high damage to battleships and above. (Use turrets for the Overmind Broodlord Omega since its signature radius is small (25m) meaning large missiles will not apply well to it and its shield tank is strong enough to shrug off what little missile damage can be dealt.)
The Grazing Phase-0 Forager deals no damage and has no EWAR, but has a lot of structure HP and can take a while to destroy.  It has the signature radius of a battleship, though.
Each wave can have up to 8 or 9 ships.

Additional waves are triggered when all non-Overmind/Forager ships are destroyed.

Once a certain number of enemies from the last wave are destroyed the rest of the ships warp off and the site is considered complete.
Completing the site awards a 8,500,000 ISK payout from Triglavian Collective. The ISK is scaled depending on how many people run the site.

Incursion fitting principles.title: Incursion fitting principles
Incursion fitting principles.description:
Incursion fleets rely rely on good resists, sufficient buffer, command bursts and active logistics. There are simply too many enemies to be able to fit a strong enough local tank, not to mention that by sacrificing a small portion of your fleet to bring in logistics instead of more damage dealers, the rest of the damage dealers can fit more offensive modules and your fleet will perform better.
Once you have a good enough tank, the rest of your spare slots should be used to augment your (and the fleet's) damage potential. While being undertanked is obviously dangerous, being overtanked is not only wasteful, but can present a a different kind of danger if done at the cost of offensive capability.
See Preparing for Incursions for more information about what skills we ask that members of the EVE University Incursion Community have trained. While other communities might have similar requirements, this is just what we recommend.

It is not deadspaced so can be warped to at distance.

Kyan Magdesh and escorts are actually at Barkrik I - Asteroid Belt 1. This means that there is a chance that COSMOS belt rats are on grid. Kyram Magdesh and the belt rats are independent entities for aggro and can be separately handled. There is also a possibility for an NPC mining fleet or actual player miners to be at work at the site.
If Kyan Magdesh and escorts are not present they have been recently destroyed and you have to wait for them to respawn. Respawn time looks to be at least 15 min after destruction, but considerably longer times have been observed.
Kyan Magdesh is the source for Kyan Magdesh's DNA which is required for Purging Ani - Kyan Magdesh (3 of 3)

Labyrinth.title: Labyrinth
Labyrinth.description:
Labyrinth is an Amarr COSMOS site located in Aphi. The site needs to be scanned with core probes. The site does not move so a bookmark of it is permanent.
At the warp-in point there is one acceleration gate: "Gate to the Labyrinth". The gate requires "Key to the Labyrinth" and Archaeology I. The key is received as a reward from The Curator. The key is not consumed on use.
 Visiting the Labyrinth is not required by any COSMOS agent or mission, but the center stage spawns many relic containers with loot that is required to build COSMOS storyline items. The Labyrinth is heavily farmed.
Navigate the Labyrinth using the map:  the orientation of the gates relative to the sun or the North indicator can be used.
There is 1 shortest path using a restricted gate (up to BC or T3C) and 2 shortest paths using a battleship.

Lafuni Oduntra.title: Lafuni Oduntra
Lafuni Oduntra.description: Lafuni Oduntra is a level 4 Minmatar COSMOS agent located in DUO-51.

Lair of the Snakes.title: Lair of the Snakes
Lair of the Snakes.description:
--You can accept this mission remotely.--
Objective
Clear the area of Serpentis pirates and ambush the personal transport in Harerget
Notes
--You can complete this mission and accept the next one remotely.--
You will warp in about 25 km from the Serpentis base (named Serpentis Research Laboratory), which will be guarded by five Serpentis frigates.
When you destroy the second reinforcement, a Serpentis Personnel Transport will appear at 70 km and warp off. It is worth noting that it is not actually necessary to destroy the base - which requires a lot of ammunition - in order to complete the mission.
If you want to destroy the Serpentis Research Laboratory (with a lot of DPS/ammo) note that it is usually the closest base to you (there are 4 in a diamond pattern).  Quicker than destroying all the other ships if you want to blitz.

The Personnel Transport warps out shortly after arrival.

Next Mission: Data Retrieval

Languishing Lord.description:

You'll be told to fly to an asteroid (about 20k away). Then you watch for a minute, and the mission completes. Do not engage any of the ships that appear. Bring a fast ship like a shuttle or a frigate.

Mission objective is completed after Lord Manik and the mercenary leave the area.

Learning by Doing.description: Report to Katsen and bring a ship for the last mission.

Longing Leman.title: Longing Leman
Longing Leman.description:
Video: [Probe June 2021]
Blitz: Create bookmark while warping in. Warp to the bookmark. Warp to the Encrypted Communications Array at 0 km. Hack the Container and Warp out.
Tips:

You will need a Data Analyzer module to hack the Encrypted Communications Array. The mission does not provide you with one, so you'll have to get one yourself.
This is not a combat mission. It is not necessary to destroy any NPC ships, and they seem to not attack you unless you get close.
If you do wish to engage the NPC fleet, either kill the elite frigates quickly and speed-tank or be prepared to tank an extreme amount of incoming damage.
The Outpost Defender fighters alone do a combined total of ~500 DPS EM/Thermal. The battleships will use microwarpdrive to quickly close in on you and do a combined total of 1500 DPS at 60km range.
This mission can be accepted remotely.
Single ungated pocket. The defenders are 100 km from warpin while the container is 20 km away.
Loot:
Approximately 30M isk in loot and salvage.
Loot+ Salvage: 40.7mil 9-June-2024

Loyalty Points.title: Loyalty Points
Loyalty Points.description: Loyalty points (LP) are part of the rewards for missions (for the corporation your agent belongs to), Incursions (for CONCORD), and Invasions (for DED). You can also earn loyalty points for each of the four factions doing Factional Warfare. Loyalty points are gained for a specific corporation and will only be useful in loyalty point stores owned by that particular corporation, with the exception of CONCORD LP that with some limits can be converted to loyalty points with another corporation.

Lunuin Eurek.description: Lunuin Eurek is a level 4 Angel COSMOS agent , located in K-X5AX. Lunuin offers the following missions.

Maekor's Plantation.title: Maekor's Plantation
Maekor's Plantation.description:
Maekor's Plantation is a static COSMOS deadspace complex found in Barkrik system. The site needs to be scanned down with probes. Alternatively you can warp to Planet V moon 3 where the site is located.
The complex is two pockets deep and allows all ships up to battleship size to enter. However, you need to bring an Imperial Navy Captain Insignia I to use the acceleration gate to the first pocket. The insignia is consumed on entering, but they are available in the market.

Magye Pirates.description: Magye Pirates is a static site which can be found in the Otomainen system. You can warp to Otomainen VIII - Asteroid Belt 1 without needing to scan down the site.

Major Conduit.title: Major Conduit
Major Conduit.description:
This combat anomaly is found in either Bulwark or Second Liminality systems. It is a harder and more advanced version of the Minor Conduit site.
They contain 6 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 16-20 ships in each.
Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces. 
Major Conduits no longer exist.

Making Money with Hauling - Level 4 Carg.page: Making Money with Hauling - Level 4 Cargo Missions
Making Money with Hauling - Level 4 Carg.title: Making Money with Hauling - Level 4 Cargo Missions
Making Money with Hauling - Level 4 Carg.description: There are few good ways to make easy ISK if you are new to EVE. One of these ways is to run distribution missions with a specific corporation, eventually qualifying to run level 4 missions.

Making an Arrest.title: Making an Arrest
Making an Arrest.description:
Travel to destination, and watch the explosion. There's no combat so you can travel in a shuttle.
This mission can take place in a lowsec or a highsec system near Nishah, and cannot be completed remotely.
Note: If the route from Mission 15 to Mission 16 takes you through or near the Palas system, it may save time to leave your combat ship in Palas and continue to the Mission 16 destination in a shuttle or rookie ship.
You will be instructed to fly towards Harkan's Manor, which will explode a couple of seconds later. (Using a pod will not trigger the explosion.)

Makor Desto.title: Makor Desto
Makor Desto.description: Makor Desto is a level 4 Minmatar Republic mission agent in Minmatar COSMOS located at Hjoramold Gate in Barkrik. This agent requires 9.90 standing with Minmatar Republic.

Mamo's Backyard.title: Mamo's Backyard
Mamo's Backyard.description:
Mamo's Backyard is a scannable combat signature [OUI-560] in Lirsautton system. It is a static site so it will always be in the same place so a bookmark of it never expires.
The warpin of this site houses Mamo Guerre, an agent in Gallente COSMOS. The second room contains some light combat.

Marked for Death.title: Marked for Death
Marked for Death.description:
Objective
Assassinate Izia Tabar located within the Hek system.
Notes
Warp into the encounter. Be cautious. At first, you will see a pack of five Mercenary Rookie ships at about a 20 km distance. Destroying them will trigger a second wave of five Mercenary Rookie ships. After eliminating all 10 ships, the named ship Izia Tabar will spawn. He is your mission target and is notably fast and heavily armored. Engaging him directly is recommended.

Optional Objective:* The in-game prompt may suggest destroying the Amarr Tactical Outpost located near Izia Tabar's position. However, this action is not necessary to complete the mission. Engaging the outpost is unconfirmed to provide any benefits and may (unconfirmed) lead to a standings hit with the Amarr Empire. To avoid potential negative consequences, it is advisable to focus solely on eliminating Izia Tabar and his escorts.
On mission completion, Keita Eslin will comment: "You have done exceptionally well, <Pilot>. Our teams will head over to Tabar’s compound now and comb the area for further evidence. Get back to me when you are ready for one last assignment. It is about time the Minmatar repaid you for all you’ve done, and I have some information about how we can make that happen."

Next Mission: Thwarting the Succession

Maschteri Markan.title: Maschteri Markan
Maschteri Markan.description:
Maschteri Markan is part of Gallente COSMOS. It is given by Ampsin Achippon located at Contested Gallente Azure Canyon in Colelie system in Algintal constellation. This is the only mission this agent gives.
 

Your mission is to retrieve Maschteri Markan's Insignia. This item is dropped by Maschteri Markan who is located at Colelie Planet VI - Moon 3 in a scannable cosmic signature called "Temko Surveillance Outpost". But to make things hard he respawns only every 5-6 hours. If the insignia is available on contracts it is most likely a good idea to just buy it.
Maschteri has extremely high Kinetic resists (80%), so avoid dealing Kinetic damage if you want to complete the mission as quick as possible. He has much lower Thermal resists (50%) which should be the damage used to destroy him.

Meet Sinas.description: Report to Sinas Egassuo twelve jumps away in Astoh at the Caldari Navy Relay Nexus Beacon.

Mercenary Distractions.title: Mercenary Distractions
Mercenary Distractions.description:
Objective
Kill the mercenaries protecting the Guristas facility, then report back to Immuri Asaka - Location: (0.9) Hatakani
Notes
This mission is about as simple as they get. You will warp in at 33km from some Guristas frigates. Kill them, then return to the Asaka's station to complete the mission.
Agent Asaka will then report to you: I’m pleased to inform you that everything went smoothly with the transfer. One of the first things our new commander did was to request frigate and cruiser backup for his fleet. They should be capable of defending themselves if the drones try to fight their way out.

Next Mission: An Economy Under Threat

Metaliminal Meteoroid.title: Metaliminal Meteoroid
Metaliminal Meteoroid.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

The objective of Metaliminal Meteoroid sites is to mine out the large central asteroid while being attacked by hostiles. The hostiles do not need to be killed to complete the site.
The asteroid contains 5,000 units (20,000 m3) of one of five mutanite ore types. This ore can be sold to NPC buyers in the region for an additional 25 million ISK. Residue (such as on Miner IIs) will help complete the site quicker at the cost of some lost ore.
The composition of the enemy forces varies from site to site, see Hostiles below. No new enemy ships will spawn unless any are destroyed, in which case they will eventually be replaced by reinforcements. 
Some enemy ships will aggressively target drones. Mining drones are fragile!

Mining mission reports.title: Mining mission reports
Mining mission reports.description:
This list contains normal missions that you can receive from Mining division agents.
For general information on how these types of missions function, see Mining missions.

Mining missions.title: Mining missions
Mining missions.description:
Mining missions are given by Mining agents and require you to mine an asteroid or set of asteroids in a mission pocket - usually until the asteroids are depleted - and bring the ore back to the agent.

Higher level mining missions require you to mine larger amounts of ore:

Level 1 missions will require mining up to 2,000 m3 of ore,
Level 2 up to 6,000 m3 of ore,
Level 3 up to 9,000 m3 of ore or 10,000 m3 of ice,
Level 4 up to 45,000 m3 of ore, 20,000 m3 of ice or 5,000 m3 gas.
Thus, you can do high level mining missions with a low level ship, but it begins to take more time than it is worth.

Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade.title: Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade
Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade.description:
Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade is a Minmatar COSMOS  site and the location of the mission The Audesder War Effort, Striking At The Blockade (7 of 8) in the Minas Iksan mission series. Both Minmatar Republic and Gallente Federation ships will be found in this brigade.

WARNING: In order to get to the Minmatar Command Post, you need to destroy the Extremely Powerful EM Forcefield which will cause -0.24 standing hit towards Minmatar Republic.

Minmatar Brigands.title: Minmatar Brigands
Minmatar Brigands.description:
Minmatar Brigands (NLX-810) is a static  Minmatar COSMOS site that can be found by probe scanning in Nakugard. It is co-located with Nakugard VIII - Asteroid Belt 10 so alternatively you can skip the scanning and warp to the belt. 

As the site is co-located with an asteroid belt there is a very real chance of belt rats showing up. As this is a COSMOS area they will be of the special COSMOS variant with a chance of dropping Recruitment Center Data Log or Finger Bone.

Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm.description:
Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm is a DED Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in Minmatar high security space.
The entry to this site is limited to T2 and Faction frigates and below.

They contain 5 waves of Triglavian NPCs containing 12-15 ships in each.
Clearing this site helps the EDENCOM forces.

Minor Perimeter Reservoir.title: Minor Perimeter Reservoir
Minor Perimeter Reservoir.description: Site text: Fullerite is the solid-state manifestation of fullerene molecules and can be found naturally occurring within interstellar gas clouds. Fullerites are coveted for the unique structural properties that make them some of the most useful materials known to humankind. Fullerene-based technology has applications in electronics, propulsion and engineering as well as the construction of ultra-hard metal alloys and heat-resistant weapons systems. Because of the near-identical processes involved in crystal formation, fullerite clouds are acquired using the same, pre-existing gas harvester technology that has supplied booster manufacturers with their own cloud materials.

Mission Hubs.title: Mission Hubs
Mission Hubs.description:
Some players who run missions will aim to try to build up standings with particular NPCs corporations. For this objective it helps if one can run missions for the corporation that also directs to a Storyline Agent of the same corporation every 16 regular missions because not only does faction standing increase with Storyline missions but corporation standing also increases.
For every 16 missions of the same faction and level that are completed you get a storyline offer from the nearest Storyline agent of the same faction and the mission offered will be of the same level (Storyline Agents transcend levels). "Nearest" is determined by the number of Stargate jumps from the regular agent who gave you the 16th regular mission. There are two exceptions. First, if you already have an Offered or Accepted mission from the nearest Storyline Agent that you haven't declined, failed, or completed yet, then your next offer will come from the second-nearest Storyline Agent. Second, if your 16th regular agent is in High Security then you will never get the triggered storyline offer from any Storyline agent in Low Security. (However, depending upon their proximity to LowSec, the mission might send you into LowSec.)
If two or more such storyline agents are equally distant then it's random as to which agent will send you an offer.

Mission mining.title: Mission mining
Mission mining.description:
This article is based on Jen Loo's post in the, no longer existing, IVY forums. Also see the EVE-Survival's Mining in Missions page for information that may be missing from here.

Mission mining is defined as harvesting the asteroids that are commonly found in deadspace combat/encounter missions.  Different missions have different amounts of ore, often varying based on the enemy fought (Guristas vs Serpentis vs Angel Cartel) and the level of the combat mission.  Some of these mission ore pockets can be harvested on the first day and will then respawn after the daily downtime.  In addition, you'll be presented with a known volume of ore with no competitors.  
The general strategy to remember is that you should always be careful to avoid completing objectives if you want the ore to respawn after downtime.  This means avoiding killing key structures that will trigger completion of the mission.  In some missions, completion can be triggered by using the acceleration gate to move to the next mission pocket.  So your goal should be to do as little as possible inside the mission area if you want to mine the mission ore all week.

NPC naming conventions.title: NPC naming conventions
NPC naming conventions.description:
When running missions or killing rats in asteroid belts, you can gleam a lot of information is given through the names of the NPC ships you're fighting.

The main part of the name indicates the ship class (e.g. frigate, destroyer, cruiser...).
The prefix or suffix indicates if the rat is an Elite ship or a Commander.
Elite ships inflict greater damage, have much higher resists, are often faster, and are more likely to bring Webs, Warp Disruptors, or EWAR than non-elite ships of similar size. Additionally, they have a higher probability of attacking your drones.
Commander Ships: Inflict greater damage and have a better range than a regular rat of the same class. Commanders tend to be rare spawns, and can also carry Faction Items as loot.
Every ship also has a "flavor name" (e.g. Ambusher, Raider, Reaver...). Differently named ships have slightly different stats and abilities, and may use either short-ranged or long-ranged weapons or a different ammo type, however on the whole ships of a given size are fairly similar.
Note: This does not mean that only Elite ships can tackle you, it only means it's more common for them to do so. This information is intended to give you a general feel for the Rats you'll be facing in missions; for specific information on rats you'll need to look at mission walkthroughs.

Note: Rogue Drones are the only Faction with a ship class lower than Corvette (like a drone for a drone), this Drone is called an Apis.

New Players Guide to L4 Mission Fleets.description:
For players who enjoy PvE missions, flying with others in a mission fleet can do much to augment the experience, both financially and socially. This guide covers the basics of flying with a mission fleet for the first time.
During these fleets, members pull Level 4 ("L4") missions from mission agents and complete them together, sharing the mission rewards and bounties. Because there is strength in numbers, these fleets can complete missions very quickly while providing an excellent opportunity for new players to run missions that they typically could not yet run while earning ISK, agent/corporation/faction standing, and loyalty points.

Ninja Salvaging and Stealing.title: Ninja Salvaging and Stealing
Ninja Salvaging and Stealing.description:
The term "ninja salvaging" is used to describe the act of following unsuspecting people around, salvaging (and sometimes looting) their wrecks without knowledge or consent for your own profit. This is commonly done against mission runners in high security space. While game mechanics allow anybody to salvage a wreck without being flagged as a suspect, doing so is still considered theft by a significant portion of the EVE community.
Stealing, or "ninja looting", is taking items from a wreck without permission. This act requires you to have yellow safeties (partial) or red safeties (turned off) and will flag you as a suspect. With green safeties (full) you will simply not be able to take loot from someone else's can or wreck. While some people do steal things for the sole purpose of selling their spoils, this is more often done mainly for the purpose of becoming a suspect in an attempt to lure you into shooting them so they can shoot back without CONCORD interfering.

Otitoh VII- Moon 19.description:
Otitoh VII- Moon 19 is a COSMOS site with Kazka Enemies guarding the Kazka Loot Container, which contains Goru's Shuttle, for Goru Nikainen. You will have to destroy all Kazka ships before being able to open the Container. After about 15 minutes, Kazka ships will respawn. After about 10 minutes, Kazka Loot Container will refill itself.
Apart from Goru's Shuttle, Kazka Loot Container also drops random commodities and industrial components.

Otomainen VIII – Asteroid Belt 1 is a Caldari COSMOS site located in Otomainen.
Here you can farm 30x Raytio Family Supplies by the spawns for Tamoko Raytio. Note that any NPC can drop it.

Our Man Dagan.title: Our Man Dagan
Our Man Dagan.description:
Your selected agent will tell you to fly to the designated location to take out Dagan.
This is the third and final difficult mission of the epic arc. It is even more difficult than Mission 48: Chasing Shadows and Mission 28: Burning Down the Hive. This is not because of the incoming damage or EWAR pressure, but because Dagan himself is extremely well-tanked for an enemy of this mission level.
Dagan is flying an exotic Society of Conscious Thought battlecruiser: a Gnosis. Dagan's ship repairs its shields at about 100 EHP/s, so you'll need to bring a ship that can deal more than 100DPS. Depending on the damage type that you are dealing, you may need to adjust this figure (lasers will need upwards of 120 DPS to break Dagan, for example.) You can preview how much you DPS your ship can do in the ship fitting screen. It is recommended to bring a destroyer or a cruiser.

Outgrowth Rogue Drone Hive (10/10).description:

This site can be found by scanning cosmic signatures or as an escalation from Drone Squad, Drone Patrol, or Drone Horde.

Outside the Scope.title: Outside the Scope
Outside the Scope.description:
Starting conversation with Veine Coructie in station completes the mission objective.
Tip: Make Undock Spot and Safe Spots in system first before docking and talking to agent.

Panic Response.title: Panic Response
Panic Response.description:
Single ungated pocket.

The Sentry Group has 100km range and spawns several seconds after warp in.
The Amarr Energy Neutralizer Sentry III is very tough to destroy. Be forewarned - it has a massive tank.
Last ship destroyed in each Hull Group will spawn a duplicate group.
Mission is flagged as complete and all remaining ships despawn when any one of the following occurs:

Battleship destroyed
Energy Neutralizer Sentry III destroyed
Either of the Chain Groups destroyed
The sentry group will not despawn and will continue to attack you after the mission is flagged complete.
Blitz: Kill the battleship, warp out once mission is marked completed.

pockets.heading: Sentry group
lines: 1x Sentry (Amarr Energy Neutralizer Sentry III) — Energy Neutralizer

Partners in Crime.title: Partners in Crime
Partners in Crime.description:
Minmatar COSMOS mission
Agent: Temer Rugaert
Agent location: Magins of Error (Tvink)
Standings required: 3.00
 

The Spatial Analyzers can be found by hacking the containers in Contested Minmatar Army Complex or by purchasing them from the market. This mission gives no faction standings and can be repeated.

Passing the Buck.title: Passing the Buck
Passing the Buck.description:
Your agent Irichi has added few extra organs to Kipo “Foxfire” Tekiras body making him a walking bomb. Your job is to deliver him to the enemy so that their station can be blown up and you get access to the deadspace complex.
Blitz: Drop Kipo “Foxfire” Tekiras to the structure in first room. Kill triggers in second room, blow up the storage. Grab mission item and return to agent.

Passive Observation.title: Passive Observation
Passive Observation.description:
Objective
Scout out the drone hive and report back on friendly vessels - Location: Hatakani
Notes

There's no danger here if you don't shoot at anything. You'll warp to an acceleration gate. Activate the gate, and you'll emerge into the deadspace room at 75 km from the massive Drone Hive. There are also eight rogue drone ships, but they will not attack if you leave them alone. Fly towards the Drone Hive - the mission objective will be fulfilled when you are about 10 km from it. Return to Asaka's station to complete the mission.

If you do decide to attack the Rogue Drones, this is what to expect:

Next Mission: House of Records

Pend Insurance Storage Bin.title: Pend Insurance Storage Bin
Pend Insurance Storage Bin.description:
Pend Insurance Storage Bin is an COSMOS site in Fluekele system in Algintal constellation. This site shows up as a warpable beacon in overview. The site consists of single ungated normal space pocket. 
The storage facility in this site drops items needed in a Gallente COSMOS mission. You can keep killing the storage facility to gain more items but they are not needed for anything and are not valuable. The rats do not agress you when you arrive or when you destroy the storage. However, you will incur -0.24 standing loss from Gallente Federation upon destroying the Pend Insurance Storage Facility.

pockets.heading: Structures
lines: 1x Structure (Pend Insurance Storage Facility) — Mission item Zemnar and various other commodities.

notes: Mission item Zemnar and various other commodities.

Pioneer's Sanctuary.title: Pioneer's Sanctuary
Pioneer's Sanctuary.description: Pioneer's Sanctuary is a Caldari COSMOS site in ZH3-BS. It is home to several agents:

Pioneering Spirit.title: Pioneering Spirit
Pioneering Spirit.description:
Pioneering Spirit is the second part of the ORE epic arc Fractured Legacy.

Video: [Fractured Legacy 18 November 2025] [Fractured Legacy guide 22 November 2025]
Accepting the mission will grant a Basic Mining Survey Chipset.
The actual mission is within 2-6 jumps away.
4000 units of Veldspar Isotope needs to be mined and transferred to an SOE Odysseus (You may need to update your overview if you don't see it).  You need to mine the ore with a volume of 2,100 m3. Use rightclick on the Mining Surveyor (button next to your HUD on the right when in a mining ship) to open the Mining Survey Results (after clicking it once) to distinguish between the rocks you need to mine and which are decoys.
On accepting the mission, when not in the correct fitting:

pockets.heading: Asteroids
lines: 4x (Veldspar Isotope 2/100 m3) — Asteroid; This is the 'ore' needed for the mission

notes: This is the 'ore' needed for the mission

Pith-Robux Asteroid Mining Co. is a DED 1/10 Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in high security or low security space.
This site's acceleration gate allows only Frigate class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. The "Scratched and Dented Keycard" can also be found in the Leaking Caskets in the Haunted Yard.

Places to Hide.title: Places to Hide
Places to Hide.description:
Choose between:

the High Security path, slow and difficult, Little Fingers
the Low Security path, fast and risky, Oldest Profession
the random Security path, quick and risky, Octomet Plantation
Your choice has no lasting impact on the Epic Arc.

Planning the Operation.title: Planning the Operation
Planning the Operation.description:
Pick between:

Sabotage 101
Brassy Faced Bastard
Your choice has no lasting impact on the Epic Arc.

Planting the Body.title: Planting the Body
Planting the Body.description:
Warp into the deadspace mission room and place 1 unit of Wolf Burgan's Body Double into “Wolf Burgan's Hideout” container. There will be 12 enemies protecting this container and they will fire on you. Few more will also spawn once the body has been placed in the container.
You can choose to fight them or just rush in, place the DNA, and warp out. You will take a lot of damage as you get in range of the drop-off container. Use an afterburner, if you can, to maximize your speed.

Playing All Their Cards.title: Playing All Their Cards
Playing All Their Cards.description:
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket one jump away from Aldrat. You can warp around freely.
Blitz: warp in, hack the Drive Cluster Archives and warp out.
Tips:

Data Analyzer is required to open the Drive Cluster Archives
Warp in is 20 km off the Drive Cluster Archives
Ships appear when you are 5 km from the Drive Cluster Archives
Tech II Data Analyzer has a 6 km which means ships will never spawn
Enemies spawn 100 km away, so you can hack a few timeout without fear of being killed

pockets.heading: Structures

Playing It Safer.title: Playing It Safer
Playing It Safer.description:
Ungated deadspace pocket up to twenty nine jumps away in Faurulle.
Complete the Mission remotely.
Tips:

Remember to take the S.I Formula Sheet (0.1 m3) from the Item Hangar
If S.I Formula Sheet is destroyed you will fail the Epic Arc and you will have to try again in ninety days
You can get to Faurulle in Solitude either through Aridia or Syndicate Regions

pockets.heading: Structures (60 km)

Polar Bear Nebula.description: Polar Bear Nebula is one of those few gas harvesting sites which, like Icy Nebula, is a COSMOS site as well. Therefore, the site is heavily guarded by pirate NPCs, but the amount of Minable gas makes it worth running.

Pre-Emptive Opportunities.title: Pre-Emptive Opportunities
Pre-Emptive Opportunities.description:
Blitz: Destroy the Caldari Logistics Center (Caldari Station1) and GFTFO, DPS will build up. Destroying the station will cause any rats currently on grid to despawn, but waves which have not been triggered yet will continue to spawn if you stick around. Station has quite a lot of HP, about 250K HP total. 950DPS applied right from the start will do it right before the spider drone wave. This mission can be completed remotely and the next mission accepted remotely.

Ungated normal space.
The station drops 1x CPF.HYA LogInt Facility POI-26: Data Cache that you can keep as a souvenir.
Warning: Prioritize targets and eliminate EWAR threats asap. Reinforcement Waves are time based (3-5min) with no trigger. The final wave is very strong, might consider getting help from friends.
Note: The Mercenary Wingmen may web and point. The Spider Drones are very quick. After warping to the location you will receive the following objective - Destroy The Logistics Center. No additional waves spawn when shooting the Logistics Center. However, it does have a lot of armor and structure points. If you destroy the Logistics Center, and stay in the deadspace pocket, additional waves (up to the final wave) may continue to spawn.

Blitz: take the Gate, take the Gate again, salvage the Shuttle Wreck.
Complete the Mission remotely.
Tips:

All Acceleration Gates are unlocked
There is no Minmatar Republic Faction Standing loss
Depending on your ship and salvage chance you may not be able to survive long enough to salvage the Shuttle Wreck; destroy a few ships first
Use a Microwarpdrive or a Micro Jump Drive to lure the Fleet way from the Shuttle Wreck
Remember to fit a Salvager module (Salvage drones do not work)

Raid.title: Raid
Raid.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

The Raid site features a central structure, a friendly NPC Freighter, and a defending hostile fleet tasked with protecting the area. During the encounter, hostile haulers will periodically spawn in close proximity to the structure and immediately attempt to align and warp out to safety.  
The primary objective is to tackle and destroy at least 4 of these haulers before they can escape, then recover their cargo (each with a volume of 3500 m3) and successfully deliver it to the freighter located on the field. All of this must be accomplished within the strict 20-minute time limit, adding pressure to act quickly and efficiently.  
Be advised that some enemy ships (see Hostiles below) will aggressively target any launched drones.

The NPCs in the warp-in area and the first pocket are at 0. The second pocket NPCs are roughly 50-60 km away.
Remember to switch resists modules for this mission or the incoming kinetic damage will hit to your resist hole.
Kinetic damage is much more important than thermal, both incoming and outgoing.
The battleships with higher bounty will deal much higher damage than the ones that have lower bounty so you should take them out asap.

Recovery.title: Recovery
Recovery.description:
Objective
Acquire 1x Mysterious Statuette (1 m³), and drop it off at Doctor Canius' station at Lisudeh IV - Moon 4 - Theology Council Tribunal.
You will be given the relic analyzer so you don't need to bring your own.
Notes
Fit the Civilian Analyzer before departing. Fly to the designated site in Lisudeh and recover the artifact from the dig site using the analyzer module. You will have to fend off several Blood Raider rats in the dig site. After you destroy them all, you will need to target lock the Ancient Tomb Dig Site and activate the Civilian Analyzer.
Once the hack is complete you can open its cargo and loot 1x Mysterious Statuette. That completes the mission. Return to Doctor Canius.
This may be your first attempt at the Hacking minigame. The wiki link will explain everything you need to know about this feature within EVE. The design of this particular hack seems to be awkward - if you hit more than one firewall (there's two in total) then you're unlikely to be able to hack the System Core as well (which you need to hack in order to get the required item for the mission). The good news is that you can repeat the hack attempt as often as you need until you succeed. It also serves as a gentle introduction to hacking, which can be a profitable part of EVE.
You can hack the relic can before you kill the guards, but you cannot open it until they are killed. Can also use any Relic Analyzer, does not have to be the provided Civilian.
Note that if you directly approach the relic can from warp-in, you will likely bounce off of a rock formation.
Update 6/10/2020: Frigate for me was a Corpii Seeker or Collector, both with tracking disrupt. In three runs, had: 3 cruisers, 1 frigate; 2 destroyers, 1 cruiser, 2 frigates; 2 cruisers, 2 destroyers, 1 frigate. In all three, the frigates did not spawn until after one initial ship was destroyed. All frigates had tracking disrupt.
On turn in, Doctor Canius says: "Blood Raiders? You're lucky you lived. They're psychotic and bloodthirsty, literally. Their sect believes purity can only be reached by consuming blood, and clone blood are purest of all. I'm afraid that makes you Capsuleers their favorite snack. But you're alive, and you've got the artifact, so we're good."

Next Mission: Of Quiet Nights Long Past

Right Tool for the Job.title: Right Tool for the Job
Right Tool for the Job.description:
Video: [Myrmidon January 2021]
Ungated deadspace pocket one jump away. Do not forget to equip a Data Analyzer.
Blitz: Warp at range and bounce to the Federation Navy Shipyard, destroy all the frigates guarding it, and loot the FedNav F.O.F Identifier Tag AC-106V:FNSBR (The shipyard needs to be hacked through the Data Analyzer & Hacking minigame before you can loot).
Tips:

You can warp in at range and land closer (or farther) from the Federation Navy Shipyard. If more than 150km away, you can warp directly to it; create a bookmark before you land so you can quickly bounce to it
The Broadcast Tower Group will not shoot at you unless you get close (they will if you warp to 0)
Broadcast Tower Group receives reinforcements every 2 minutes three times
All ships will drop Gallente Navy Tags
If you plan on tanking, destroy the Cruisers first
Negligible standing loss to the Gallente Federation for destroying enemy ships
Buy Caldari Prisoners of War and bring them with you so you can instantly complete the next mission

Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.title: Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation
Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation.description:
Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation is a DED rated combat site found in high and low security space. It is often regarded as a low value site as it contains no faction drones and has a very low chance to drop a single faction module.
Interestingly, the site can have low amounts of Rogue Drone alloys in the cans in the last two pockets that can be reprocessed for minerals.
There are minable asteroids of Omber and Veldspar, but the site will despawn shortly after the drones guarding the Scratched Cask in the last room are defeated, preventing them from being mined unless someone stays in the site, although you do have enough time to go to a nearby station to drop off.
While mining the ore in the site, pirate rats (based on which empire space you're in) can randomly appear, their strength relative to the system's security rating.
