Royal Jelly.title: Royal Jelly
Royal Jelly.description:
Objective
Evacuate the Food Relief Personnel (15 x FR Personnel - 15.0 m³) from the area. You might get surprised by rogue drones. Stay on task, though. Location: Arnon
Notes
This is a rescue mission - and it is remarkably easy if you have a fast ship, despite a large number of rogue drones that will fill your overview. Fit a micro warp drive (MWD) or an afterburner to your ship, if you can. When you warp to the mission location, the Habitation Module will be about 80 km away. Head towards that container at top speed. Rogue drones will begin to appear, and appear, and appear - about 30 of them, in total - at ranges of 50-75 km away. Don't panic - you have plenty of time to pick up the personnel and get them into your cargo hold, as the growing swarm does not attack right away. When they finally do, it comes piecemeal, only a few rogue drones at a time. You do not have to destroy them - just pick up the personnel and return to the Arnon IX - Moon 3 - Sisters of EVE Bureau station to complete the mission.
Sister Alitura will be thankful: Bless you for saving those people. I know you didn’t do this out of charity, but your help is appreciated anyway. You have been paid, but when you’re ready, I have another lead on this drone.

Salvage Research.title: Salvage Research
Salvage Research.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

The pocket contains 30 wrecks that must be salvaged within 20 minutes. Mobile Tractor Units (MTU) and tractor beams do not work on the wrecks—you must approach each wreck and use high-slot salvage modules or salvage drones directly. Be aware that hostile ships can target and destroy salvage drones.
Hostile ships will spawn and engage you. These can be ignored if your tank is strong enough, speed-tanked if you’re fast, or destroyed depending on your fleet composition. 
A Malfunctioning Werpost is located in the pocket. It can be activated with a Data Analyzer module; once online, it will attack enemy ships with its disintegrator weapon. For more info please read: Hacking.

Salvagers must have at least a 20% Access Difficulty Bonus to function (Salvaging IV or a rig is required). At 20%, these sites are quite difficult; 30–35% is recommended.  For more info please read: Salvaging.

Sansha Burrow.title: Sansha Burrow
Sansha Burrow.description:
Sansha Burrow is an unrated combat site belonging to the Sansha's Nation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Amarr Empire and Ammatar Mandate. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. 
This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships.

As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable True Sansha faction modules and ammunition. 
This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-, Destroyer- and Cruiser-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Sansha's Nation Neural Paralytic Facility complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Sansha Hidden Den, Sansha Forsaken Den and Sansha Forlorn Den.

Two different site layouts can be encountered: The Light Missile Battery layout and the Heavy Missile Battery layout. Both layouts can spawn a True Sansha Cruiser and escalate.

The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Battlecruiser class or smaller.
This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.

In this mission you will need to travel through multiple deadspace pockets and burn hundreds of kilometers to reach the next gate in them. The briefing says that MWDs won't work but that is outdated information and they do work.

Sealing the Deal.title: Sealing the Deal
Sealing the Deal.description:
Objective
Destroy the Society spy ship at the designated location in Arnon.
Notes
When you arrive at the mission location, find the Society Spy, an Independent Green-Crewed <playable ship name> - this is the ship you want to destroy. Ignore the 7 frigates. After you destroy this ship, the frigates will de-spawn and you'll get a pop-up message from another agent, Adani Yusev: "I’m Adani Yusev from Ishukone internal security. We’ve been monitoring data traffic between you and the Servant Sisters of EVE. No, don’t get excited. We’re all on the same side, here. The State will help you get Dagan… as long as you hand him over to us once you’ve got him." Seems like all of the different factions want Dagan!
On turn in, Sister Alitura says: "Excellent work. The Omnipresence has been destroyed, and there’s no indication that she managed to inform her Society masters. We’ll be resuming contact with Karin immediately."

Serpentis Den.title: Serpentis Den
Serpentis Den.description:
Serpentis Den is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). 
Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate to Cruiser-sized enemy ships, as well as some batteries. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site complex.
Serpentis Den.escalation: This site can escalate to Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site.

Serpentis Hideaway is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration as a cosmic anomaly within systems owned by the Gallente Federation or occupied by the Serpentis Corporation. As an ungated complex, the limitations as to which ships can complete this site are tied to the security rating of the system where the anomaly spawns (T2 Battleships for high-security systems, and up to Titans in low-security and null-security systems). Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules and ammunition. 
This combat site consists of a single ungated pocket of space containing a variety of Frigate-sized enemy ships. Destroying all hostile ships may escalate into the DED rated Serpentis Narcotic Warehouses complex. Three variations of this combat anomaly exist: Serpentis Hidden Hideaway, Serpentis Forsaken Hideaway and Serpentis Forlorn Hideaway.

Ship progression in Incursions.title: Ship progression in Incursions
Ship progression in Incursions.description:
There are a lot of ways to spend ISK on your incursion character in order to improve your performance, be that buying a pirate faction battleship, getting faction and deadspace modules or injecting implants into your head. Some of these options are more effective than others, so before you start "throwing ISK at the problem" with wild abandon ... take a moment to consider your options.
In general we suggest making upgrades following this rough order, designed to prioritize upgrades which require less time and ISK investment and which provide the largest benefit:

We suggest that unistas use the loaner battleships provided by the Incursions Community until you can afford to buy a Pirate Faction Battleship. At that point, you should buy yourself the full starter fit for your preferred hull.
You should at this point train towards the appropriate Tier II weapon system for the hull you have chosen.
Following this, as you gain ISK, you should replace modules, slowly upgrading from Tier II to faction or deadspace.
You could also consider at this point training Cybernetics V and buying a WS-618 warp speed implant.
Once you have fully upgraded your Pirate Battleship, you should consider training into the Marauder which shares a weapon system with your current ship (Vargur from Machariel, Kronos from Vindicator, Paladin from Nightmare).
Following buying and fitting a Marauder, you should finish by completing your implant set following the Implants Guide.

Showtime.title: Showtime
Showtime.description:
Showtime is the hardest Epic Arc Mission. You have to fight 5 Elite Battleships that deal 1500 DPS in omni damage and approach you at 1000 m/s. You will need to overheat, manually pilot, create bookmarks, use long range weapons and propulsion modules to defeat them. Consider asking a friend for help.
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket three jumps away in Adacyne. You can warp around freely.
Blitz: Destroy all Battleships, then destroy Rosulf Fririk. Pick up Ralie Ardanne from the Cargo Container.
Tips:

Either keep Pator 6 Elite Battleships at 140 km or be prepared to take 300 DPS from each as every is equipped with:
125 Explosive DPS, 148 km range Missiles
80 EM, 32 Kinetic and 64 Explosive DPS, 34+44 km range Turrets
1000 m/s propelling Microwarpdrive
Addendum: It seems the Pator 6 Elite Battleships rarely use their MWD at ranges of 80km and under.
It is suggested to use an MWD battleship (600-700m/s should be sufficient) and stay at 60+ km to avoid taking full damage. The Pator 6 Elite Battleships' turret fire is speed-tankable if you have a decent MWD.
Alternatively, an MJD sniping battleship or marauder works well. Make sure you either have the range to stay out of range completely or the tank to hold under DPS pressure.
Afterburner-fit Tech III or Heavy Assault Cruisers can orbit at close range and speed tank. The Elite Battleships have relatively poor tracking speed and their missiles don't apply well to anything smaller than battleships.
The Elite Battleships will attempt to starburst out to ~40 km if you are too close to them. Try to force them to stay relatively clumped together if you rely on speed tanking, since you will have low transversal against individual battleships if you let them spread apart and cause them to ramp up a lot of damage.
The Pator 6 rats deal primarily a mix of EM and Explosive damage, while Syndicate Battleships deal Kinetic/Thermal. Thus, it is recommended to omni-resist tank for the mission (but primarily Ex/Th), or switch before triggering the battleship wave.
Sniping battleships can easily stay out of range of non-explosive damage, or all damage if past 148km. Cruise Ravens are ideal for this, or a cruise Praxis/Typhoon with missile-range-extending mods. Create bookmarks as you warp in to bounce between.
Facetanking without use of a marauder is not advised for this mission, as you will need the ability to handle over 1800 DPS (omni damage types) for extended periods of time.
If you are taking heavy damage, align out to a station and warp away if needed.

Smuggler Hideout.title: Smuggler Hideout
Smuggler Hideout.description:
For more information about the game event see Capsuleer Day XIX

The Smuggler Hideout is a Capsuleer Day XIX event site. It consists of two gated pockets. You have to clear most of the NPCs in the first pocket to make the acceleration gate to the second pocket usable. In the second pocket your goal is to destroy the Smuggler Underboss which drops various loot. The number of NPC spawns and their size depends on the highest ship class used, especially T3 cruisers lead to significantly more NPCs. The number of ships entering doesn't affect the spawns though. A full clear will net you 7.5 million ISK in bounties (before tax).

You will face 2 waves of Society of Conscious Thought, EDENCOM and CONCORD NPCs that will need to be destroyed in order to spawn the boss wave. The site will appears as a beacon in the overview when warped to. This site does not provide any bounties as you will fight non pirate NPCs. The second wave appears to be timed, so it can spawn the boss if you take too much time to clear this wave. This site features the new Soct frigate : Metamorphosis

Some Light Theatrics.title: Some Light Theatrics
Some Light Theatrics.description:
Video: [Probe January 2021]
Ungated deadspace pocket one jumps away in the same System.
Hack the CPF Habitation Module with a Data Analyzer and grab the CPF Security Personnel (15 m3). CPF Habitation Module will explode thirty seconds after you've hacked it. The explosion damages ships in 10 km range.
Tips:

Do not warp out before the CPF Habitation Module explodes
If you let the CPF Security Personnel explode inside the CPF Habitation Module you will fail the Epic Arc

Spy Games.title: Spy Games
Spy Games.description:
Gated deadspace pockets are one jump away in AJCJ-1.
Blitz: kill Eroma Eralen, take Acceleration Gate then another Acceleration Gate. Arc around to the opposite side of the Forcefield, destroy the Caldari Bunker with a 16 km range weapon and Tractor Beam the Correspondence Log KL-513 Cargo Container.
Alternative Blitz: kill Eroma Eralen, loot the Caldari Navy Overlay Transponder, take Acceleration Gate then another Acceleration Gate. Approach the Caldari Bunker, destroy each wave as it spawns and then destroy the 150 HP/s regenerating Forcefield.
Tips:

Orbit Eroma Eralen at 3 km to avoid damage
If you don't attack the friendly ships, they won't attack you
Caldari Bunker reinforcement waves spawn as you approach the Caldari Bunker
All Caldari Bunker reinforcement waves will spawn when you attack the Caldari Bunker or on proximity to the Forcefield.
Enemy ships can't pass through the Forcefield (unless you encounter a bug where all ships can pass through the Forcefield)
Caldari Bunker drops two Cargo Containers: one has ammo and the other the Correspondence Log KL-513
You will lose 2.4% Caldari State Faction Standing when you destroy the Caldari Bunker (Note: Also lost standing for destroying the forcefield AND NOT the bunker)

Stabilize Rift.title: Stabilize Rift
Stabilize Rift.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

The Stabilize Rift requires your fleet to prevent the Sleepers from collapsing an active abyssal rift. The enemy has anchored five Destabilizing Arrays, which must be drained of capacitor and held below 20% simultaneously to break the destabilization cycle.
Destroyer-class vessels equipped with energy neutralizer modules and combat drones are advised. Sleeper reinforcements may attempt to neutralize your capacitor or restore power to the arrays, forcing a prolonged engagement. 

This mission demands strict coordination and precise execution. Success will stabilize the rift and will allow free passage for the Triglavian caravan.

State Protectorate.title: State Protectorate
State Protectorate.description:
This article describes the Caldari State faction warfare corporation. For information about faction warfare mechanics, see Faction Warfare.

We are the State, and we have claimed our long-lost homeland. Now we are at war; united, whole and full of fire and purpose. The State calls you, capsuleer, for it needs your strength and your leadership to fend off the encroaching Gallente menace. The State will not fall. Join us. Fight. Conquer.

Stillwater.title: Stillwater
Stillwater.description:
Accept the Mission remotely.
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket within 2-4 jumps of the previous mission. You can warp around freely.
Blitz: kill Karkoti Rend, loot the Book Of St. Arzad and warp out.
Tips:

Destroy the EWAR Angel Energy Neutralizer Sentry II first as it has 250 km range and drains 20 GJ/s
Karkoti Rend's Battleship projects 500 DPS up to 150 km away (decreasing with distance) and approaches at 1000 m/s if over 40 km away. Damage split is ~ 28% EM / 11% Kinetic / 61% Explosive.
Karkoti Rend has similar EHP to a Gist Seraphim (~45s to kill with a T1-ammo cruise Praxis), so it's best to focus him directly after the tackle frigates and neutralizer to quickly blitz the mission.
When you kill Karkoti Rend, all other ships will warp out.
Incoming damage will be quite variable depending on the ship types that predominantly spawn. EM and Explosive damage are the most prevalent overall, though.

Storyline mission reports.description:
This is a list of reported storyline missions.  Note that Storyline mission offers ignore the division of the Storyline Agent; an agent listed in the Station Services window as "Storyline - Mining" could give you a combat mission, for example.
Encounter missions only really need the volume column used when bringing something to or from the mission location is part of the objective.

Studio I.title: Studio I
Studio I.description:
Studio I is among the hardest Epic Arc Missions. You have to fight up to 6 Elite Battleship with 300 DPS at 40 km that approach you at 1000 m/s. You will need to overheat, manually pilot, create bookmarks, use long range weapons and propulsion modules to defeat them. Consider asking a friend for help.
Gated semi-deadspace pocket two jumps away in Osmeden. You can warp around in both rooms freely.
Blitz: strongly discouraged; destroy all ships at warp-in, take the Gate and destroy Studio I Structure.
Tips:

Complete the Mission by destroying the Studio I Structure
The Studio I has about 150,000 hitpoints, evenly spread out across shield, armor and hull
Studio I drops the Holoreel: Wanted for Love lore item
Warp at 100 km and use propulsion modules to keep away from Elite Battleships
Create Bookmarks and warp between two of them to get distance from the enemy
Use miscellaneous Structures as warp points
Align to a Structure and warp away if you need to
Overheat your Shield or Armour modules
Destroy Frigates and Cruisers first, although the frigates are extremely slow and not a threat to snipers
Elite Battleships will try to approach to 10km, while normal battleships will stay at 50km; both have difficulty tracking an afterburning cruiser.
3% Syndicate Faction Standing loss for destroying the Studio I Structure. Normal Syndicate faction standing loss for ship kills, even the Pator 6 frigates.

Surfacing.description:
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket 11 jumps away in Jark. All warps will land you at the same point, but you can warp around freely.
Blitz: loot the Encrypted Transmission from Tili's Brothel with a fast ship (or ping to it in your combat ship). Warp out and bring in a combat ship. Kill all Battleships.
Tips:

Mercenary ships spawn at 25 km range several seconds after Encrypted Transmission is removed from Tili's Brothel
Mercenary Cruisers deal EM/TH while the Battleships deal KIN/TH
Mercenary Wingmen rarely use Warp Disruptors, but always Web
You will be traveling another 11 jumps back to Aldrat to complete the mission, but the remaining missions there can be blitzed in a frigate (with a Data Analyzer), so you might want to leave your combat ship near Jark, since you'll be coming back through there next.

Suspicious Signal.title: Suspicious Signal
Suspicious Signal.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

The objective of this site is to destroy a single tower-like structure located at the center. At the start, the structure is either invulnerable or cloaked, and it only becomes vulnerable once three hackable arrays (data cans) are successfully hacked. Each hacked array activates a 90-second timer. If all three are hacked around the same time, this creates a 90-second damage window on the tower. The tower has 350,000 HP with no resistances.
Be advised that some enemy ships (see Hostiles below) will aggressively target any launched drones.

When you arrive only Ailon Boufin and the Archives are present
Ailon Boufin's lowest resistance is 72% Kinetic Shield and Armor
Reinforcements arrive when Ailon Boufin takes shield damage and then again when they take armor damage

All reinforcement waves will actively repair ~500 HP every 10 seconds or so.

If you are unsure if you can kill Ailon Boufin with Remote Repairers present, kill the reinforcements wave by wave first. Consider fitting for maximizing damage application or having at least 500 DPS pure volley damage to quickly break through the remote reps.
If you overestimate yourself, you'll spawn all ships at once and make the Mission a nightmare
Create a Bookmark and warp to it to avoid taking significant damage
Place Ailon Boufin's passkey into the Archives to spawn the Hauteker Memoirs

The Paths That Are Hidden.title: The Paths That Are Hidden
The Paths That Are Hidden.description:
This mission has 3 different branch options. The final reward of this Epic Arc is based on your decision here. Choosing either "Two Two Steps Into Hell" or "Playing It Safer" will side you with Nugoeihuvi and you will later be able to chooce either Nugoeihuvi reward or Caldari state reward. "An Honorable Betrayal" on the other hand will side you with Hyasyoda allowing you to choose either Hyasyoda reward or Caldari State reward later.
Even though the Hyasyoda path contains more missions it may be faster than Nugoeihuvi path. The Hyasyoda path contains six "talk to agent"-missions (three of which can be completed without moving at all), one courier mission and one "hack a single container"-mission. Nugoeihuvi path on the other hand contains one "talk to agent"-mission, one courier mission and one combat mission.
As of 2023, the Prefer Safer autopilot option plots a 31-jump route through mostly-empty lowsec to Faurulle, with a further two jumps into nullsec for KFR-ZE, both of which are typically empty. Consult the map if you're worried, but the nullsec option is usually worth the extra 10 million ISK, even though that's the only difference between the two if you're doing the Hyasyoda path.
Note: Making the selection completes the mission.
Two Steps Into Hell
Deliver S.I. Formula Sheet to the Nugoeihuvi Cargo Facility in KFR-ZE (Syndicate) in Null Security (27 jumps though null route). The final reward will either be from Nugoeihuvi (20x Nugoeihuvi Synth Blue Pill Booster + Caldari State standing) or from Caldari State (ISK + Caldari State standing) depending on your choice later.
Playing It Safer
Deliver S.I. Formula Sheet to the Nugoeihuvi Cargo Facility in Faurulle (Solitude) in Low Security (30 jumps though low route). The final reward will either be from Nugoeihuvi (20x Nugoeihuvi Synth Blue Pill Booster + Caldari State standing) or from Caldari State(ISK + Caldari State standing) depending on your choice later.
An Honorable Betrayal
Report to Arikio Kuretsu in Wuos (Wuos V - Moon 1 - Hyasyoda Corporation Mining Outpost) in High Security. (Make sure to bring S.I Formula Sheet). The final reward will either be from Hyasyoda (1x Hyasyoda Research Lab Blueprint + Caldari State standing) or from Caldari State (isk + Caldari State Standing). Even though Hyasyoda path seems much longer it isn't much longer than Nugoeihuvi path as most of the extra missions are very fast "talk to agent" missions. After talking to Arikio Kuretsu you will come back to choose between the other two options.

Notes: The mission is in ungated semi-deadspace which means it allows warping inside the pocket, although you will always warp to the mission location when warping from outside the pocket. Create a bounce bookmark as you land on grid for easy repositioning.
The cruise missile batteries will hit battleships hard. You will want to take them out soon. For smaller ships, primary the Stasis Towers as they will make speed-tanking difficult.
Ishukone Operational Reports will drop from a can next to you when you get near the station. Picking it up is not required to complete the mission.
Killing NPCs is optional but they drop Caldari Navy insignias, which can be profitable (approx. 25M). No standing loss for killing them.

Completing this mission ends the Caldari epic arc.

Tracking the Queen (Part 1).title: Tracking the Queen (Part 1)
Tracking the Queen (Part 1).description:
Objective
Get the Scope reporter, Corin Risia (1 m³) and return him to Sister Alitura at the Arnon IX - Moon 3 - Sisters of EVE Bureau station

Possible glitch on mission reads "and destroy his captors." This will not let you turn in the mission by snatch and grabbing Risia. Warping back to the mission and briefly engaging frigates allowed mission completion of the mission. Note: In this instance, Mordus frigates were heavily tanked and used web and point. I warped out when scram failed.
Notes
Fit an afterburner or micro warp drive on your ship if you can - speed helps here. When you warp into the mission, Risia's Wrecked Ship container will be about 45 km away. Make a beeline for it, and loot it to put Risia into your cargo hold. When you do this, you'll see seven Mordus frigates appear at 45-60 km range. You do not need to destroy these ships to fulfill the mission - just warp back to Sister Alitura's station before they can get in range. If you wait too long, the enemy frigates will web you - don't wait around to let this happen.

The Bounty Hunter leaves its group and rapidly approaches. At about 20km the web starts.

Next Part: Tracking the Queen (Part 2)

Tracking the Queen (Part 2).title: Tracking the Queen (Part 2)
Tracking the Queen (Part 2).description:
This is a simple high sec courier mission. Don't forget to move Corin from Items in the station to your ship cargo hold. Take Corin Risia to his hideout at Attyn V Moon 2 station (two high-sec jumps) so he can transfer the rogue drone data to you.

Next Part: Tracking the Queen (Part 3)

Tracking the Queen (Part 3).title: Tracking the Queen (Part 3)
Tracking the Queen (Part 3).description:
--The mission can be completed remotely and the next mission can be accepted remotely.--
Load the tracking data to a jet can at the designated mission location - don't forget to put the data container into your ship first. When you do, you may encounter six Mordu's Legion frigates at close range who will attack you. One will web you if you are within 10 km of that ship. You are not required to kill them to complete the mission. Fit an afterburner for speed, if you can. If you get destroyed and lose the Drone Tracking Data, don't worry. You can repeat the mission, but standings WILL be lost. TIP: Kill Mordus first, then get tracking data from station and put it in ;-) 

Next Mission: Burning Down the Hive

Traffic Stop.title: Traffic Stop
Traffic Stop.description:
Main article: Homefront operation

This 3 man Homefront Operation site is found throughout high-security Empire space. The only regional difference is the types of haulers and what damage types they are weak to.
The objective of Traffic Stop is to prevent haulers carrying contraband from reaching the station. These haulers will warp onto the grid in waves, you must cargo scan the haulers and if any of them possess contraband data, you need to destroy them. Once any hauler is aggressed, it will deploy drone frigates to attack your ships and begin accelerating rapidly until it reaches the station and docks.
The shuttles can be ignored as they never carry contraband.
Pilots should resist  EM, the damage dealt by the escort frigates in all regions. There is no hostile EWAR.

This site takes the full 9 minutes, and you need to ensure both victory criteria are met: (1) don't let 5 ships carrying contraband dock up; and (2) don't shoot or kill more than 2 civilians. The mission will fail if either of those occur prior to the 9-minute timer on the site ending. Partial progress in these failure conditions (such as letting 4 smugglers through) has no effect on site payout.

Two Steps into Hell.title: Two Steps into Hell
Two Steps into Hell.description:
The mission area does not have combat. Simply drop the formula sheet in the container. The mission can be completed remotely. This courier mission takes you to null, take normal precautions in Null Sec, such as never warping directly from gate to gate to avoid bubbles. If you lose the mission item you will fail the epic arc, you can retry three months later. Interceptor is very much recommended ship to use.
Upon reaching KFR-ZE you will need to warp to a semi-deadspace pocket (open the right-click menu -> Agent Missions -> Two Steps into Hell -> Encounter).  Upon landing deliver the S.I Formula Sheet intothe container named "Cargo Facility 7A-21.
A Pochven filament can be used to get back to mainland in 15 minutes. Use inbound filament to enter pochven, wait the timer, use outbound filament to return to normal space. Large numberof pochven systems are from Caldari space so if you are lucky a proximity filament will leave you in Caldari space.
If you took this mission from "The Paths That Are Hidden" your next mission will be Too Close for Comfort (Nugoeihuvi path).
If you took this mission from "Re-examining Options" your next mission will be Almost Unmasked (Hyasyoda path).

There are three different Factions that you need to destroy

Urban Management’s Census - Civilian In.description:
Minmatar COSMOS mission
Agent: Ekdit Spitek
Agent location: Dream Port (Inder)
Standings required: 2.00
Parts: (1 of 3), (2 of 3), (3 of 3)
 

This mission includes long distances to burn and some light combat. Frigate with MWD is very much recommended.
The warp in area is called "Forward Point" and has three gates labeled Alpha, Beta and Gamma. They are approximately 110km-112km away.

Other helpsites imply that the initial gates Alpha, Beta and Gamma always lead to the same rooms. This is untrue. Sometimes Alpha will lead to Yttora's Corpse, sometimes Beta, sometimes Gamma. Its random.
One gate will fly you to a room which has a gate labeled "Gate to Foward Point" and will be guarded by 4 Maru ships (Punks and Hackers). They sometimes use webs and scramblers.
One gate will fly to a room with an unguarded gate labeled "Ancient Acceleraton Gate" that is approximately 176km away. That gate in turn flys you to a room that has yet another gate labeled "Gate to Forward Point". This Forward Point gate is guarded by 1 Maru Sniper and 5 Maru Punks. These ships can webify.
One gate will fly you to a room which has an unguarded gate labeled "Ancient Acceleration Gate" that is approximately 226km away. THIS is the correct path to Yttora's Corpse. Flying thru this gate will put you in an unguarded room that has two gates, 240km - 290km away, labeled "Accleration Gate Alpha" and "Acceleration Gate Beta".
Using Acceleration Gate Alpha will fly to you a room that has a container icon labeled "Ship Wreckage" guarded by 3 drones. The container and drones are approximately 178km - 185km away. The container has Yttora's Corpse inside.
Using Acceleration Gate Beta will fly you to a room that has an uguarded gate labeled "Ancient Acceleration Gate" approximately 200km away. Flying though this gate will put you in yet another room that has a gate labeled "Gate to Forward Point", guarded by 7 drones that can (but not always) both web and scramble.

  Wightstorm Forward Base is a highsec combat anomaly that appears inside Volatile Ice Storms during the Winter Nexus event in 2020, 2021, 2023 and 2025.

If a capsuleer is present at the Forward Base it will appear in the Overview of every capsuleer in the same System.
Enemy ships can warp to tactical bookmarks and often target drones. They deal EM & Thermal damage with lasers, and Kinetic & Explosive damage with missiles, similar to their Incursion counterparts. Frigates have a 50k ISK bounty, Cruisers 125k, Battlecruisers 250K and the Battleship 2M. Only the Battleship drops loot.
Similar to other event sites post-2019, the site is doable with a well fit Battlecruiser with application support. One of the event challenge texts recommends a T2-fit Battleship.

World Ark Assault Flashpoint.title: World Ark Assault Flashpoint
World Ark Assault Flashpoint.description:
World Ark Assault Flashpoint is a Triglavian Collective combat anomaly that can be found in Pochven. It was originally created during Invasion Chapter 1, and re-implemented in Chapter 3, which is the form it remains in.
The World Ark Assault is an extremely long and difficult site, and little formal research is available on it due to its extremely limited availability during Chapter 3. Only four confirmed runs of it were completed during Chapter 3, and each run took roughly 45 minutes. As the site only exists in Pochven, fleets preparing to attempt it must account for the Dazh Liminality Locus effects (reduced target lock count but increased remote repair strength).
The site is hidden behind an Acceleration Gate. Once a ship has attempted to warp to the site, a system-wide-visible Beacon will spawn at the acceleration gate. The site consists of a large ring containing numerous Triglavian structures, centered around a single, invulnerable and untargetable, Xordazh World Ark.
Every ship which enters the site will sustain roughly 2000 damage from the 'Pozhlost Denial Zone' upon landing on grid with the Ark. This is enough damage to destroy small, untanked frigates, and thus discourage loot theft, however it will not significantly damage larger ships.
The actual combat consists of roughly 10 waves of Triglavian ships. Most ships will be Hospodar-grade, with numerous Zorya-grade in each wave. Each wave consists of 20-50 ships of assorted sizes. It is unknown whether waves are trigger-based or time-based. These waves can include Pylon-Dropping Kikimoras.
In addition to the normal waves, the World Ark will deploy Entropic Disintegrator Werposts and Field Effect Subpylons. Up to 2 Werposts can be on the field at a time, and when destroyed will respawn after several minutes. A Field Effect Subpylon will spawn roughly every five minutes. There are five Subpylon variants, one of which will spawn at random. Subpylons have 130,000 HP, 0% resists, and apply a significant electronic warfare effect to capsuleer ships near them.

World Ark Deployment Site.title: World Ark Deployment Site
World Ark Deployment Site.description:

Wormhole sites.title: Wormhole sites
Wormhole sites.description:
This is a full list of wormhole space exploration sites.
Cosmic anomalies and ore sites are warpable (colored green) in the scanner window when you enter a wormhole system, and do not need to be scanned down. Data, relic, and gas sites, on the other hand, must be scanned down. There are no DED complexes or acceleration gated rooms in wormhole space, with the exception of the Drifter wormholes, which are very specific in many ways and not the concern of this article.

Wrath of Angels.title: Wrath of Angels
Wrath of Angels.description:
Accept the Mission remotely.
Gated deadspace pocket up to seven jumps away.
Blitz: take the gate and kill Yukiro Demense.
Tips:

You do not need to kill the Cruise Missile Batteries. They lose aggro past 50-60 km so if you pull Yukiro Demense far enough they will be no threat.
Yukiro Demense minimum resistance is 64% Kinetic Shields and Armour
Wait until Yukiro Demense is at least 40 km away from the Remote-Repair Facility Structure before attacking to avoid it repairing him; Yukiro Demense will approach you at 300 m/s
Destroying the Remote-Repair Facility Structure destroys the Cruise Missile Batteries but incurs an additional 3.0% Guristas Pirates Standing Loss

Written By The Victors.title: Written By The Victors
Written By The Victors.description:
Ungated semi-deadspace pocket within one jump of Frarn. All warps will land you at the same point, but you can warp around freely.
Blitz: warp in, then warp to bookmark. Warp to Central Burial Tomb, loot the Wildfire Khumaak and warp out.
Complete the Mission remotely.
Tips:

The Mission is done when you approach the Central Burial Tomb, but if you don't loot the Wildfire Khumaak you won't be able to complete the next mission.
Large ships like the Praxis will bump off of the structure before they get within 2500m, making it impossible to loot, and even frigates can easily get stuck on the structure. It might be safest to use a heavily-tanked frigate and MWD away after looting rather than trying to warp off immediately.
Approaching the structure from the domed top half at no more than ~500m/s in a ship of cruiser size or smaller will usually allow you to grab the loot most easily.
~500 DPS applied immediately after pinging to the structure
Powerful Amarr Elite Battleships will arrive only if you destroy all Battlecruisers

Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point.title: Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point
Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point.description:
The Dark Blood Fleet Staging Point is an unrated cosmic signature site that can be scanned using Core Probes in Blood Raider infested regions of Null Sec space. It may also be received as an escalation from Blood Forsaken Hub and 
Blood Forlorn Hub anomalies. The site itself escallates twice, involving travel. If both escallations go in the same direction, you could end up in hostile space for part 3.
This can be run in a single Ishtar. The site appears to not aggro on Ishtar drones, so reset the aggro if that happens. The most critical part of running this is to deal with the neut batteries. Primary them but run away while you do because incoming damage will be heavy and you won't have cap. Fits with 100mn ABs and especially drone navigation modules, to get to the neut batteries faster may be best. Note that non-capital dark blood modules vary widely in price and so the site may not be worth running. It takes a long time. I destroyed all the batteries, but I recommend only destroying the neut batteries.

Festering Ruins.description:
Festering Ruins is a combat relic site found in the Fountain nullsec region. Up to T2 Battleships can enter this site. This site appears to Probes as a combat site. 
The site is very rare and hard, and should only be attempted by skilled players. Rogue Drone, Serpentis, Angel Cartel and Guristas rats are present in this site. Omni tanks are highly recommended, especially against Kinetic and Thermal damage.
Compared to other combat relic sites, this is noticeably harder due to higher DPS, especially in the fourth and last pocket.

Sansha Watch.title: Sansha Watch
Sansha Watch.description:
An Unrated Complex that can be scanned down with scanner probes. It is commonly found in highsec systems occupied by the Sansha's Nation pirate faction.  
The site consists of a volume of space with an acceleration gate and contains various structures and their defending pirates. Using the gate allows access to other areas within the site. When attacked, the defenders may send multiple waves of reinforcements. Each group's appearance is triggered by the destruction of members of the previous group. The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly, but will always be of Cruiser class or smaller. There are two variations of the site. 
This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site. Flying too close (4 km) to the second gate will trigger a large spawn. Shoot the Sansha Mind Control Tower to get the Centum Militant Supervisor to spawn. He's got the good stuff.
The first pocket can be skipped if you have a Sansha Silver Tag in your cargo hold. This will be consumed when the acceleration gate is activated.

Serpentis Vigil.title: Serpentis Vigil
Serpentis Vigil.description:
Serpentis Vigil is an unrated combat site belonging to the Serpentis Corporation pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by scanning anomalies in high security and low security systems. It is presumed that Battlecruisers (and their Tech 2 equivalents) are the maximum ship class allowed to enter the site. Completing this complex may award the player with valuable Shadow Serpentis faction modules, as well as Tech 2 implants. 
This combat site consists of two deadspace complexes, the second of which hosts Tago Uriken, the site's overseer. Access to the second complex is given by destroying all remaining hostile ships at the first complex. Defeating Tago Uriken may escalate into the Booster R&D expedition.

Wispy Ruins.title: Wispy Ruins
Wispy Ruins.description: Wispy Ruins is a combat relic site involving both combat and hacking. It appears to Probes as a scannable combat site. Unlike most combat sites, it is only found in the Feythabolis nullsec region, specifically in the I-3ODK constellation.  A dedicated combat ship like the Vargur is highly recommended for this site. Avoid taking frigates into the site, as the smartbombs in the third and fourth pockets can easily destroy any frigate. The smartbomb damage can even be high enough to destroy a cruiser. Pirates from the Rogue Drones and Angel Cartel are featured.
